_style: Traditional Chinese ink wash painting (shui-mo) on aged warm-white xuan rice paper, masterful expressive brushwork, rich ink gradations from deep black to pale grey, generous empty white space, very subtle washes of muted indigo, ochre and cinnabar only where noted, Song and Ming dynasty literati painting sensibility, cinematic 16:9 wide composition, museum quality. No text, no calligraphy, no seals, no signature, no border, no frame.

items.g_stonecity: A lone strategist in Han-dynasty robes and a feather fan standing on a rocky cliff top at dawn, seen small from behind, gazing over a misty river plain toward a great coiling mountain range shaped like a dragon on the left and a crouching tiger-like stone cliff city by the river on the right; vast mist, a few sails on the Yangtze.
items.g_burygold: Ancient Warring States era scene at the foot of a misty mountain by a great river: a small procession of robed officials and servants burying a chest of gold in the earth at dusk, faint warm gold leaf glints from the chest, pine trees, rolling mist, mysterious legendary mood, figures small in a vast landscape.
items.g_jianye: Panoramic bird's-eye view of the ancient Three Kingdoms capital Jianye on the Yangtze river: rammed-earth walls, palace halls, river harbor crowded with wooden warships and sails, mountains behind wrapped in clouds, early morning light, subtle ochre wash.
items.g_temples_rain: Countless Buddhist temple halls and pagodas of the Southern Dynasties scattered across layered green hills, all veiled in soft drifting spring rain and mist, ink dissolving into fog, a famous poetic mood of 'four hundred and eighty temples in misty rain', faint pale green and indigo washes.
items.g_wuyi_swallows: Old Jiangnan aristocratic mansion eaves with dark curved roof tiles and white walls at sunset, a pair of swallows gliding past the eaves toward humble village houses, wild flowers by a small stone bridge, nostalgic and wistful mood, faint sunset ochre wash.
items.g_literati: Wei-Jin era literati gathering in a pine and bamboo grove beside a mountain stream: robed scholars with loose hair playing a guqin, drinking wine, one writing calligraphy on a scroll, relaxed unconventional elegance, mist between the trees, figures delicate and small.
items.g_liuxie: A Buddhist scholar monk writing by an oil lamp at night in a simple mountain temple study in deep pine forest on Zhongshan mountain, scrolls stacked around, moonlight and mist outside the open window, quiet and profound, warm faint lamplight wash.
items.g_wallbuild: Ming dynasty construction of a colossal city wall: hundreds of tiny laborers carrying grey bricks up wooden ramps, kilns smoking in the distance along the river, massive gate tower rising, dramatic scale, epic and orderly, subtle grey-blue and ochre washes.
items.g_zhenghe: The great Ming treasure fleet of Zheng He setting sail from the Yangtze river: enormous nine-masted wooden treasure ships with red-brown battened sails, many smaller ships, waves and wind, sunrise, epic grand scale, cinnabar and ochre washes on sails.
items.g_porcelain_tower: The legendary nine-storey octagonal glazed porcelain pagoda of Bao'en Temple in Ming dynasty Nanjing glowing at night, hundreds of lamps along its eaves, white porcelain and green-gold glazed tiles shimmering, temple courtyard and city roofs below, bells hanging, stars and moon, wondrous mood, delicate gold and jade-green washes.
items.g_exam: Ming-Qing imperial examination hall: endless long rows of tiny open brick exam cells under a night sky, in each cell a scholar in robe writing by candlelight, a tall watch tower in the center, solemn and vast, warm small candle glows in the ink darkness.
items.g_qinhuai_old: Qinhuai river at night in the Ming-Qing era: painted pleasure boats with glowing red lanterns drifting on the water, oar ripples breaking lantern reflections, riverside wooden houses with carved windows, a stone arch bridge, misty romantic mood, warm lantern glow and cinnabar accents.
items.g_honglou: An elegant scene inspired by Dream of the Red Chamber: graceful young ladies of a noble Qing household in flowing silk gowns in a classical garden — one reading poetry in a pavilion, others by a lotus pond under peach blossoms, falling petals, refined gongbi-meets-ink style with soft pink and jade washes, faces delicate, dreamlike and melancholic.
items.g_yunjin: Two artisans operating a towering traditional wooden Yunjin brocade draw-loom: one perched high on top pulling pattern threads, one seated below weaving, the loom frame tall and intricate, a length of brocade with shimmering gold and peacock blue patterns emerging, warm window light, reverent craft mood.
items.g_libai: The Tang poet Li Bai in white robes standing on the Phoenix Terrace at sunset, wine cup in hand, overlooking three mountains half lost beyond the blue sky and a river divided in two by an egret islet with white egrets flying, vast and free-spirited, faint ochre sky wash.
items.g_memorial: A solemn, dignified, respectful still life for remembrance: many white chrysanthemums and small burning candles before a dark grey stone wall in quiet darkness, soft rising candle smoke, restrained monochrome ink with faint warm candlelight only, no people, no text, deeply mournful and peaceful.
items.g_peace: A single white dove flying upward out of swirling dark ink clouds into dawn light over a wide river, a long double-deck steel bridge silhouette faintly visible in the morning mist below, hopeful and serene, pale gold dawn wash.
items.g_ducks: A playful humorous ink painting: a few chubby ducks swimming nervously in a row along a river past an ancient grey city wall and willow trees, one duck glancing back worried, charming and witty literati humor style, light and lively brushwork.
items.g_panorama: An epic ink panorama blending past and present of Nanjing: Purple Mountain wrapped in clouds in the back, the ancient Ming city wall and Xuanwu lake in the middle with willows, pagodas and classical roofs, and slender modern skyscrapers including one very tall twisted tower rising softly out of the mist, the Yangtze with a long bridge on the right, harmonious, majestic, morning mist.
items.g_brush: Close-up of a calligrapher's hand holding a large wolf-hair ink brush lifted just above fresh xuan paper, a drop of black ink about to fall from the tip, an ink stone and a red seal paste box beside, soft window light, shallow depth of field feeling rendered in ink wash, contemplative.
items.g_inkwater: Black Chinese ink just dropped into clear water, billowing soft ink clouds unfurling and swirling like mountains and mist, pure white background, extremely delicate gradations, macro photography feel rendered as an ink artwork, no other objects.
items.g_oldmap: An antique hand-painted Ming dynasty style map-painting of the walled city of Nanjing seen from above: irregular city wall outline following hills and lakes, the Yangtze river, Purple Mountain, Xuanwu lake, Qinhuai river winding through, small temple and palace roofs, painted in ink with faded mineral green and ochre, aged paper.
items.g_paper: A blank sheet of high quality aged xuan rice paper, warm ivory, visible delicate long fibers and subtle mottled texture, very faint uneven tone, completely empty, evenly lit, flat scan, no objects, no text, no ink.
items.g_seasons_plum: Winter plum blossoms on gnarled dark branches in falling snow, crimson-red blossoms, a classical stone path and an ancient stone statue faintly visible in the snowy mist behind, poetic stillness, cinnabar red accents.
items.g_modern_ink: A modern Nanjing night cityscape rendered as ink wash painting: Xuanwu lake in the foreground with willows and the old city wall, glittering skyscrapers including a very tall twisted tower in the middle distance, Purple Mountain dark behind, city lights as soft dots of warm gold ink, poetic and futuristic yet classical.
items.g_reading: A young woman in modern casual clothes reading a book by a large window in a quiet modern bookstore with tall wooden shelves, outside the window an ancient grey city wall and green plane trees, warm afternoon light, serene, rendered in elegant ink wash with faint warm ochre wash.
items.g_stroke: A single bold horizontal stroke of a big Chinese calligraphy brush in grey-black ink across a pure white background, sweeping from left to right, with expressive dry-brush 'flying white' streaks, frayed bristle texture at the tail and a wet heavy start, isolated on plain white, nothing else, flat scan, high contrast.
items.g_enso: A single circular ink brush stroke (enso) in black ink on pure white background, thick wet start fading into dry-brush flying-white streaks, isolated, flat scan, high contrast, nothing else.
